observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-f51438619a6b completed all 29 feedback rounds on every seed-0 task and activated score-rank mean, covariance, and step-size updates on all 145 tells, but its covariance adaptation treats all 32 latent coordinates as equally relevant when setting the learning rates. The resulting covariance movement remained finite but modest while terminal Top-1 reached only 0.204834 on median_2 and 0.196894 on sitagliptin_mpo, so the Parent has no way to concentrate its limited covariance-learning opportunity on the subset of evolving eigen-directions that carry repeatable reward signal.
hypothesis: Add only CMA-ES-LED signal-to-noise effective-dimensionality adaptation to the Parent's covariance update: estimate which current covariance eigen-directions carry persistent mean or rank-mu update signal, sum their soft effectiveness weights, and calculate the covariance-path, rank-one, and rank-mu learning rates from that estimated effective dimension instead of the nominal 32-dimensional latent width.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic MolMIM-style probabilistic SMILES autoencoder only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, using variance-conditioned latent training so local perturbations remain decodable, and then freeze it. In each independent objective session, encode the fixed evaluated starting molecules, center a CMA-ES search distribution on the best observed latent, and repeat an ask/tell loop: sample a fresh latent population from the current multivariate Gaussian, decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally replace invalid or previously seen molecules, submit only the newly decoded batch, and update the Gaussian mean, covariance, and global step size from the returned score ranks. The method neither fits a surrogate nor screens the corpus; oracle feedback changes the continuous proposal distribution directly, so coordinated latent directions that repeatedly yield better molecules receive more probability during the 290 adaptive calls. The sole success target is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.
